title: PPIA-15 Integrated Expanded Regression Workflow Contract Matrix

workflows.title: Concurrent stable-object intent under duplicate-name pressure
workflows.composition_differential: Two authorized clients select or act before seeing each other while duplicate display names are present; stable identity, operation status and conflict presentation must converge without duplicate mutation.

workflows.title: Live reveal with projection lag and semantic nonvisual parity
workflows.composition_differential: A governed reveal is accepted while live projections are open; delayed reprojection and nonvisual delivery must not reclassify the Event as failure or expose prereveal facts.

workflows.title: Entitlement loss across cached and reconnecting projections
workflows.composition_differential: Protected derivatives exist on one or more clients when entitlement is revoked, including while offline; reauthorization precedes reuse and stale protected data never flashes or survives.

workflows.title: GM modification composed only with stale-version conflict
workflows.composition_differential: Ordinary GM modification remains inherited baseline coverage; only stale-version composition is additive and any mutation semantics remain owned upstream.

workflows.title: Duplicate display names after disambiguator permission loss
workflows.composition_differential: Same-name objects remain stable-ID distinct after an authorized disambiguator becomes unavailable; reprojected labels may shrink but targeting may not drift.

workflows.title: Version conflict with status lookup and actor-owned intent preservation
workflows.composition_differential: A version advances while another actor has a stale authorized intent and an operation may be status-unknown; current-version/status lookup precedes any owning-domain resolution or retry.

workflows.title: Campaign-local override against inherited Definition update
workflows.composition_differential: A reusable Definition advances while a Campaign-local override remains in force; scope and provenance stay explicit and neither side is silently promoted, reset or merged.

workflows.title: Source-only Definition inspection separated from instantiate/add authority
workflows.composition_differential: Source browsing remains read/reference-only even when a separately governed instantiate/add command is available nearby, including on compact touch surfaces.

workflows.title: Vehicle transfer with distinct relations and stale-version recovery
workflows.composition_differential: Ownership transfer is composed with independent control, custody, crew, passenger, cargo and version state; only explicitly governed owning-domain relations may change.

workflows.title: Bounded relationship-secret reveal, observer nonleak and later revocation
workflows.composition_differential: A relationship secret reaches only its governed audience; nonrecipients remain no-secret-equivalent and later permission loss purges protected derivatives and unsafe retained context.

workflows.title: Interrupted crafting across local-draft and submitted-operation phases
workflows.composition_differential: Interruption before authoritative submission and interruption after tracked submission have different safe oracles; any retry requires owning-domain idempotency proof.

workflows.title: Reconnect during approval after accepted Event and before projection catch-up
workflows.composition_differential: Accepted approval remains accepted while the requester reconnects; projection-pending is recoverable by refresh and does not authorize duplicate approval or blind retry.

workflows.title: Large inventory deterministic filtering across visual and semantic paths
workflows.composition_differential: The 512-record case-local inventory produces permission-safe stable-ID deterministic results across pointer, keyboard, high-zoom and nonvisual paths without becoming a capacity promise.

workflows.title: Dense Creature/NPC targeting with uncertainty-bounded encounter analysis
workflows.composition_differential: The 128-record case-local target set remains stable-ID and permission safe on visual/nonvisual paths; PPIA-11 may be bounded or indeterminate but never certifies balance.

workflows.title: Unusual morphology without human defaults across desktop and phone
workflows.composition_differential: Known morphology stays semantic, unknown compatibility remains unknown and compact navigation cannot introduce human-body or spatial-map defaults.

workflows.title: Phone-only single-focus conflict review
workflows.composition_differential: Current version and actor-owned stale intent remain reviewable through sequential compact navigation; no hidden second pane or mobile shortcut may force overwrite.

workflows.title: Keyboard, screen-reader, noncolor and reduced-motion regression parity
workflows.composition_differential: Awkward conflict, inventory and dense-target states remain operable and semantically persistent without pointer, map, color or motion-only meaning.

workflows.title: Offline/read-only recovery plus explicit F024 unsupported guard
workflows.composition_differential: Authorized cached reads remain local/read-only, reconnect resolves current authority before reuse, and F024 Pack lifecycle requests remain unsupported rather than receiving invented semantics.

handoffs.boundary: stable identity, Definition/instance separation, expected version and object mutation authority remain upstream
investigation truth/belief/knowledge/reveal audience and accepted reveal Event remain upstream
relationship secret truth, recipient scope, entitlement/revocation and social mutation authority remain upstream
construction/crafting proposal, approval, cost and modify-and-approve mutation semantics remain upstream
error/recovery/status/conflict presentation cannot turn status-unknown into failure or authorize blind retry
Campaign-local override scope and provenance remain local unless owning authority explicitly changes them
Vehicle ownership, custody, control, access, crew, passenger and cargo relations remain separately authoritative
encounter analysis remains uncertainty-bounded and cannot certify balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal or guaranteed outcomes
Species/Form known versus unknown morphology and appearance semantics remain upstream; no human defaults are synthesized
device, keyboard, touch, screen-reader, high-zoom, noncolor and reduced-motion variants preserve authorized meaning and disclosure ceiling without creating authority
offline/local state is nonauthoritative; reconnect requires current authority/status resolution before mutation or protected-cache reuse
Pack lifecycle install/activate/update/remove/promotion behavior is unsupported and must not be invented

protected_nonclone_guard.rule: Do not count ordinary GM modification as new PPIA-15 coverage.
